elements.label: About
elements.value: Entered from Movement when JumpAbility.canActivate() is true. Returns to Movement when jump completes.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jumping_state.schema.json, set js_c_chain to {{js_c_chain}}]
Set jump chaining (re-jump while airborne) to {{js_c_chain}} in CharacterStateMachine.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/jumping_state.schema.json, set js_c_abort to {{js_c_abort}}]
Set variable jump height to {{js_c_abort}} in CharacterStateMachine. On = releasing jump calls abortJump().
